batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c AS Joseph b J Little

batting.name: PBB Rajapaksa
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b AS Joseph

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b MM Sharma

batting.name: SM Curran
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b MM Sharma

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c MW Short b K Rabada

batting.name: B Sai Sudharsan
batting.dismissal: c P Simran Singh b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c SM Curran b Harpreet Brar

balls.text: Oh, what a bit of work from Saha. Has he run out Brar last ball off the innings? Yes, he has. Fuller length ball outside leg stump as Brar backs away looking to flay it away. Gets a thick inside-edge with the ball going to the right of Saha, who puts in a dive to first stop the ball. He then gets up and fires in a throw, gloves on. Hits the top of the stumps and finds Dhawan short.
Fuller-length ball outside off, he times it to the right of Miller, who fires in a throw at the non-striker's end. Would have been out by mile, but Miller missed.

Fuller and outside off, he spanks it to the right of mid-off. There is a bit of misfield and Shahrukh goes for the second. But Miller throws a flat throw to the keeper who whips off the bails in a flash and finds Shahrukh short of his crease. Never run on a misfield as they say, and that has cost PBKS a wicket.
Goes fuller and very wide, outside the tramline. Called a wide.
On a length on leg stump, he drags it to deep backward square leg. They take a run.
Oh, Brar goes straight and all the way! Right in his arc, on off. He clears his front leg and sends it soaring straight over the bowler's head.
Pacy length ball outside off, he tonks the drive but to mid-off who moves to his right and saves a few runs.
Slower ball outside off, he waits for it and bunts it to deep cover.
Another slower short of a length ball outside off. He opens the face of the bat and ramps it just wide of short third.
Back of a length slower ball, 105.5 kph, outside off. He mistimes his drive to extra cover
another slower short of a length ball into the body of Brar, who pulls it to deep backward square leg
Pacy yorker on off, he digs it to extra cover

And, now Curran falls! Mohit gets his second wicket of the night. He goes into the pitch with the off-cutter shoulder high with the line outside off. Curran has to wait for it, and while he gets a good chunk on it, there is no pace. The ball goes straight to deep midwicket where Gill takes a simple catch.

Low full toss and Shahrukh goes all the way again! He is playing a little gem here. On middle and leg. Shahrukh shows his brute strength by staying deep in the crease and nailing it over wide long-on.
Fuller on middle stump, he backs away again and drags it to deep midwicket
Have no clue how Curran reached it but he did and gets a four. Curran backs away a lot, so Shami bowls it full and outside off. Curran reaches for it, and gets a cue end of the bat past the keeper.
Hit hard and on the bounce to Little at mid-off. Length outside off, was in his slot, but does not get under it enough. Hits it flat and hard.
Fuller on the stumps as Shahrukh whips it to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Angles the full-length ball into the pads of Curran, who gets a thick inside-edge onto his pads towards short third.
Banged in short into the body of Shahrukh, who is upto the task and pulls him over deep midwicket with aplomb. What a shot first ball!

End of a difficult innings for Rajapaksa! Knee-high full toss on middle stump, Rajapaksa chips it straight to deep midwicket. Easy catch for Gill running in. The batter never got going and a strike rate of 76.92 was just not good enough on the day.
Low full toss on leg stump, he backs away and mistimes to mid-off.
Fuller but down the leg, called a wide this time.

Very similar to the second ball of the over, but this time, the umpire does not call it a wide. Why was the earlier ball called a wide, and this isn't? Curran opts for the review. The third umpire says, if Curran was in his normal stance, the ball would have struck his pads. The decision stands.
Fuller on the pads of Curran who flicks it to wide long on and they take two. Rajapaksa had to put in a dive but think he was safe
Fuller down leg, Curran is well inside the line looking to hoick it away, and misses. Oh, that is called a wide. Joseph is not impressed with that call.
Full-length ball on leg stump that can only be dinked to long on by Rajapaksa.
Quicker wrong'un outside off, Rajapaksa opens the face of his bat and dabs it to the right of short third. Rashid Khan has been bowled out.
Length on leg stumps, he clears his front leg and plays it to long on
Flatter on leg stump, he mistimes his slap to midwicket.
Misses his length does Rashid and Curran clears the longest part of the boundary on the field! Fuller on leg stump. He backs away and whips it over deep midwicket.
Slower leg break on middle and leg, he shimmies down the track looking to work it to the on side. Gets a leading edge towards deep point and they take two.
Flatter legbreak on leg stump, he stays back and punches to extra cover
Gets inside the line of the length ball, but Mohit is bowling these smartly. Goes length and just outside off. Curran can only work it to deep midwicket.
On a length now on middle and leg, he can only bunt it back to the bowler
They are going nowhere at the moment, are PBKS. Back of a length ball  on the stumps that hurries Curran. He was looking for a pull, can only flat bat it to mid-off.
Dances down the track to the length ball on leg, but can only scythe it to the right of mid-off.
Good length ball outside off, he cuts it to hard but straight to deep cover
Length outside off, he pushes it to mid-off

Ooh, what happened there? Was there an edge on that? Beautifully bowled by Rashid. Slows up the wrong'un beating Rajapaksa's outside edge. Rashid's expression says there was an edge but Saha failed to hang on
Oh, he was shaping up for the sweep, but Rashid saw him and fired this fuller outside off. He changes his shot  looking to dab it away. Misses
Another quick length ball on middle and leg, he taps it to midwicket and sets off for a run only to be sent back
On a length outside, he stays back and cuts it to deep point
Flatter on middle, he bunts it back to the bowler

Flatter legbreak on middle and leg as Rajapaksa goes back, looking to flog it away. Misses and is rapped on the pads with the batter in front. A loud appeal ensues, but the umpire says no. The only thing is whether the ball was pitching in line. Hardik takes the review. The ball-tracker shows that was pitching outside leg.
Good length ball outside off, he punches it to extra cover
Ooh, goes past the outside edge again. Length ball just outside off, just shaping from the batter, who pokes at it and misses.
Short and wide and Rajapaksa cuts it hard but straight to deep cover.
Good length ball outside off, he slaps it to deep cover

Edged, is it? Saha appeals but does not get a lot of support. Pandya has taken a review in the nick of time. They are already a review down. Back of a length ball just on off that tails away from Jitesh just a touch. He pushes at it and the ball goes past his outside edge. Oh, hello. UltraEdge confirms there was a smidge of an edge on that. What a top review from Saha, who was the only appealing. The on-field umpire has to change his decision, and Kings are four down.
Back of a length ball outside off, Wade punches it to deep point for a run
Slower off cutter outside off, he is deceived by the slowness of the ball and is into the drive early. Misses it altogether.
Fuller now on off, punches it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Fortuitous but Jitesh will take it gleefully! On a length into the batter, goes for an expansive drive, instead gets a thick inside-edge just past the stumps.
Banged in short around shoulder-high into the body of Rajapaksa. He fends it awkwardly towards square leg.
Another back of a length ball on middle stump, he swipes it to the deep backward square leg fielder. Jitesh wanted a second, but is sent back again
And is welcomed with a slam back over his head. Back of length ball on middle, Jitesh stands tall and crashes it straight over the bowler's head.
On a length just outside off, he punches it hard to cover and sets off for a quick run only to be sent back and wisely so.

Poor lines from Mohit and Rajapaksa gets an easy four. Slower bouncer, around 118 kph, but the line was down leg. And the batter just helps it past the keeper. With short fine leg up, that was only going one way.
On-pace length ball just outside off, was 133.kph outside off. He plays it with an open face to point.
Slower short of a length ball on the hips of Jitesh. He is early into the pull and drags it to deep midwicket.
Back of a length again on middle stump, he flogs it away to deep midwicket.

Loud, loud appeal as Rajapaksa misses the swish and is rapped on the pads. Not give and no review taken. That was back of a length on the stumps. But too many questions. Was it in line? Was it too high?
Another of those hard length deliveries from Joseph, waist-high as Jitesh defends back to the bowler standing tall.
Play and a miss again! Back of a length ball outside off. He looks to punch it on the up, but he misses.
On a length on middle and leg, he clips it neatly to deep backward square leg for a run only
Sprays the length ball down leg does Joseph, and that is another extra added in Punjab's total
Back of a length ball into the of Jitesh who pulls it towards midwicket.
Shimmies down the track to the full-length Joseph ball looking for an expansive drive. He misses and the ball just misses the off pole by a whisker.
Ramped perilously close to Tewatia who tries to come forward to take the catch, but the ball does not carry to him. Gets his body in line and saves some runs.
Slower googly on middle stumps. Jitesh picks it early and punches it hard to the right of the bowler, who puts in the dive to save a couple of runs.
Flatter leg break on off, pushed back to the left of the bowler.
Long hop and Jitesh has laid into it. Goes back and pulls it hard over short midwicket and into the fence.
Fatter wrong'un on middle and leg, he works it to short midwicket.

Slower full-length ball on the leg stump. He reverse sweeps straight to short third and sets off for a run. Only Rajapaksa wasn't going anywhere. The third umpire is called for as Saha whips off the bails. Jitesh was in comfortably.
Flatter on middle and leg, Jitesh paddles it beautifully and the pace means the ball goes to the fine leg fence in a jiffy
Another back of  a length ball just on off. He closes the face of the blade a touch early and gets squared up a touch. The leading edge goes towards covers. They take a quick run.
Another pacy back of a length ball outside off, was 146.7kph. he looks to drive on the up, and misses
Length on middle and leg, he pushes it to long-on
Length just outside off, he gets a thick outside edge on the drive to deep third.
Whoo! That was a quick bouncer. Banged in short around shoulder-high as Jitesh has to take evasive action. That was a sharp a bouncer as any
Length on middle and leg, he works it to midwicket and they take a quick run
Drag down and duly punished! On the pads of Jitesh, who rocks back and pulls to the right of deep backward square leg. He is away with a four.
Fuller outside off, he prods forward and pushes to covers

Wrong'un that beats Short all ends up, and sees his stumps in a mess! Flatter into Short, who was looking to swipe that away. Does not pick the googly, and the ball clatters into middle and leg stump. Rashid gets the better of his Adelaide Strikers team-mate
On a length outside off, Rajapaksa lofts it down the ground to long on
Fuller on middle and leg stump, he pushes it to long on for a run
Short on middle and leg, he pulls it to deep backward square leg.
Length down, he gets an inside-edge onto his pads as the ball rolls towards the on-side with the keeper running around.
Fuller outside off, he mistimes it to Mohit at mid-off and sets off for a quick run. No direct hit, but he would have made it even if there was one.
Oh, top shot by Short. Not all that over-pitched outside off, but Short slams it through the legs of his partner for a four all along the ground.
Length ball outside off, he laces rhea drive to the right of deep cover. And some sloppy fielding gives them an overthrow.
Advances down the track, gets no connection on it but enough to clear the in-field on the on side. Back of a length ball into the body of Rajapaksa, who gets it high on the bat.
Now, Little loses his line and sends the length ball down leg. Titans need to curb these extras.
Back of a length ball just outside off, he punches it to point with an open face of the bat.

SPANKED! Joseph looks to bang that hard into the wicket, but Short waits for it and just stays still to hammer the pull over deep midwicket. That was bowled at 149kph, but Short did not care. Sends it miles into the stands.
Loses his radar once more does Joseph. Strays down leg, second wide of the over.
Back of a length ball just outside off, 149.9kph. Short pats it to point with a slight open face of the bat. he can't get the run.
On a length just on off, he plays with an open face of the blade to point
Glances it fine and fine enough to fetch a boundary! Gets it too straight on the pads of Short who just helps it to the fine leg fence.
Whacked but straight to extra cover. That was in the slot for Short, he smokes the cover-drive but can't find the gap.
Sprays the full-length ball down leg. Called a wide.
Fuller-length ball just on off as Short stays still and drives to mid-off.
Another short of a length ball into the body of Short, who is hit in the midriff with the ball going towards the on-side. They pinch a leg-bye
Goes a touch fuller now outside off, he drives on the up to covers.
back of a length ball just on off and middle, he pushes it to the right of the bowler.
back of a length ball just outside off, he punches it confidently through covers for a run

Huge, huge wicket for Titans as Dhawan departs! Good length ball on middle and leg, he shimmies down the track looking to loft it over mid-on. The bat turns in his hands a touch and he ends up ballooning it straight up. Alzarri Joseph runs back from mid-on and ends up taking a comfortable. So, the man who has been scoring all the runs for Kings has to go. Hardik is elated!

Loud appeal from Little as Dhawan looks to work the length ball on middle and leg away. Saha shouts, 'shayad ho sakta hai' (think it might be out)! And Hardik has reviewed.  Ooh, Dhawan seems to have got an inside edge on to the pads, a tiny one. The umpire's decision stands and Titans lose a review.
Sprays the length ball down leg, now does Little. Called a wide.
Good length ball that comes into Short, who looks to whip it away once more. But this one skids through and hits him on the thigh pad. A stifle appeal from Shami, but that was probably going over.
Short, wide, and Short lays into it again. Deep point was in place, but nothing he could do. Cuts it hard through covers. The ball is speeding away on this outfield.
In the slot and Short has absolutely climbed into it! Over-pitched outside off, he does not bother to move his feet much, and absolutely pummels it to the left of mid-off.
Short of a good length ball just on off that whipped away by Short through midwicket for a couple of runs
Goes for some extra pace but loses his radar does Shami as he sprays it way down leg.
Nips back into the batter this time around does Shami. Is on a good length on off. Short misses his swish.
Back of a length again outside off, he punches it hard but straight to cover
That's driving of the highest order! Length ball just shaping away from the batter, who plants his front foot forward and crashes the drive past mid-off. No one moved.
Shimmies down the pitch again as Short hangs the length just a bit back. He watches it carefully and lets the ball go.
On a length now just on middle as Dhawan pushes back to the bowler
Up and over and Dhawan is away! Jumps down the track to nullify the swing outside off. Opens the face  of the blade and lofts it over covers for a four.
Just a bit of nibble as Little keeps it up around off stump. Dhawan accounts for the swing and defends to covers
Full-length ball with a hint of swing away from Dhawan, who looks for an expansive drive on the up but misses
Back of a length once again on middle stump. Short pushes it to mid-on.
Banged in and Short is upto the task once more! Swivels and pulls him through the square leg region. He didn't time it all that well but the outfield is lightning quick.
Lovely way to get off the mark! Back of a length ball just outside off, he rides the bounce and punches it through point for a four.
Back of a length again that hits Short high on the thigh pad as he eye a swipe

Shami gets a wicket second ball! Innocuous back of a length ball on the hips of Prabhsimran who was looking for a flick. But the ball hits the high part of his blade and lobs straight to Rashid at short midwicket, who takes a simple catch.
Just a hint of shape into the batter first up as he pushes it towards midwicket. Rahid swoops on the ball and fires in a throw at the non-striker's end. Dhawan had come down looking for a run.

And Tewatia has done it! It's full outside off, and Tewatia moves across and scoops it over fine leg for four. He punches the badge. He has done it before for his team and he does it again tonight! Another excellent final over by Curran today, after the one bowled by Nortje the other day, but again, there were too few runs to defend

It's all happening! Yorker on middle, Miller gets an inside edge onto his foot. Tewatia sprints down and has reached the striker's end before Miller can even start his run. Jitesh throws it to Curran but by the time he can turn around, Miller is through
Almost a yorker on off and Tewatia is able to dig it out to long-on for a single
Cleaned him up! Is this too late for a late twist? It's full on off and angles in just enough to hit off-stump as Gill swings and gets an inside edge. Late, late twist? Sign me up!
On a length outside off, Miller slaps it hard to Rishi Dhawan at cover and he almost throws the stumps down at the striker's end. Gill escapes by a whisker!

Goes for the yorker around leg and it goes off his boot to fine leg. Arshdeep wants to review this as the umpire turns down his appeal. This looks like it hit him outside leg. No bat on it and ball-tracking confirms that the impact was indeed outside leg
Angles it in full outside off and Gill drives it out to long-off
Arshdeep goes short and Miller pulls it out too deep square
Full on middle and Miller misses his flick. That was going down leg through
Pitches it up outside off, Miller drives punchily to wide of mid-off and they pick up two. They now need a run a ball
Bangs it in short outside off and Gill pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
Beats fine leg, and that should be it for Gujarat! It's short on leg and he swivels and pulls behind square. It goes away for four and Titans now need just 13 off 12
Rabada goes short again and Miller has a swipe at it and misses
Back of a length just outside off, Gill punches it to long-on for a single
Take that! Stands still and pulls a short ball on off away in front of square and it goes all the way!

A little bit of a scamper but they make it through. It's on a length and going across him, Miller gets an inside edge onto himself and the ball rolls to his right but Gill is already halfway through for the single. Miller takes off too and Rabada targets the wrong end and both batters are in safe
Digs it in short on middle, Miller guides it to backward point
Just short of good length outside and quite wide, Miller reaches out and cuts to point for a quick single
Works it away to deep midwicket for a single
What was that?! It's short on off, and Gill almost plays a tennis forehand that flies past the non-striker and races away. Played that with a diagonal bat, with the toe-end pointing upwards
Length ball on off, Miller pulls it away to deep midwicket
Full on off, Gill whips it away to long-on
Ouch! Curran goes short and Miller misses his pull. The ball hits him on his hips and goes towards point as they run the leg-bye
On a length on leg, Miller wants to play it square but misses and it comes off his pads behind square leg and they take a run
Full on off and Gill drives along the ground to long-off
Oh, this is gorgeous stuff from Gill. Presses forward to a full ball on middle and off and lofts it inside-out and picks the gap between long-on and sweeper cover. Brings up a fifty too!
On a length on off, he pushes it out to cover
On a length on leg, he hangs back and nudges it square
Swung away just over midwicket. It's full on off and Miller skips out and whips it aerially but it's just over Dhawan
On a length on off, Gill clips it through midwicket and immediately sets off for a single. Brar gives chase but Rahul Chahar comes in from the deep to collect and throw it to the non-striker's end
Tossed up full on off, he drives it to cover and Rabada can't hold on to it. Miller gets another single
Tossed up full around off, Gill drives it back pas the bowler to long-off for a single
Full on middle, Miller clips it to midwicket and a fumble allows him to take a quick single to get off the mark

Brar gets Hardik! He clears his front leg and wants to go big down the ground but doesn't quite time it. Picks out Sam Curran  who takes it reverse-cupped. He lets out a little roar as the Titans skipper walks back
Tossed up full on leg, Gill whips it away to deep midwicket
Oh my! If anything, Hardik is seeing it better now! It's pitched up outside off and Hardik plays as classy a cover drive as I have seen. Leans into it and caresses it between cover and mid-off
Oooh an absolute snorter! Banged in short and it grazes Hardik's helmet and flies over the keeper for four
Full on off, he drives it to mid-off again
Back of a length, slower ball, on off, Hardik punches it out to mid-off
On a length on off, Gill hangs back and clips it through midwicket
Short on off, Hardik pulls to deep square leg
Full on leg, Hardik whips it away to deep midwicket
Quick and flat, full on leg and Gill clips it in front of square
Speared in full on leg, Hardik backs away and drills it out to long-off
Strays onto the pads this time and Gill nudges it through midwicket
Lobbed up full outside off, Gill drives to extra cover
Darts it in full on off and Gill drives it back to the bowler
Full on middle and off, pushed defensively to mid-off
Short, just outside off, and Gill cuts it to deep point
On a length on off, Hardik opens the face of the bat to steer it past point to get off the mark
On a length on off, Hardik punches defensively to short cover
And Arshdeep has the breakthrough! Bangs it in short on off, Sai Sudharsan swivels and pulls but gets a top edge and it goes straight to deep fine leg!
On a length on middle and leg, going across him, Gill clips it out wide of mid-on
On a length on off and angling into him, Gill clips it square and finishes the over with a single
Short and wide, he pulls it away to deep midwicket
Wide and on a length, Sudharsan goes to cut but misses
Sai Sudharsan on the charge! Skips out to a full ball outside off and chips it back over the bowler's head
Gill sweeps a full ball outside off to deep midwicket for another single
Short outside off, he cuts it to sweeper cover
Loopy delivery outside off, Gill again finds extra cover with the drive
On a length outside off, Gill drives to extra cover
Tosses it up full on middle, Sai Sudharsan digs it out through mid-on
On a length around off, he chops it to short third
Drags it down leg and Gill nudges it to fine leg. Good running between the wicket as they steal a single
Big shout for caught behind as Gill goes to cut a length ball outside off. Was there an under-edge? Umpire says no
On a length on off, he chops it back to the bowler
Tossed up full on off, Gill this time eases it to long-off
Shot! too full from Chahar and Gill launches it over extra cover for a one-bounce four
Darts it in on a length on off, Sai Sudharsan clips it to deep square leg
Tosses it up full outside off and Gill leans into it and eases a drive to long-off
Dropped too short and Gill pounces on it. Hangs back and cuts it past Arshdeep at short third
Full on leg, Gill clips it out to deep midwicket. Another mis-field, but this time they will settle for the single
Another near-yorker, this time just outside off, Gill squeezes it to mid-off and races away for the single. Chahar spills it as he tries to collect and Gill races back for another
Yorker just outside off, Sai Sudharshan gets his bat down on time and squeezes it behind square on the leg side and gets a single
Full on off, he finds the cover fielder with his drive
Another short ball on off, this time he swivels and pulls through midwicket for two quick runs
Curran bangs it in short on off and Sai Sudharshan ducks underneath
Tossed up full on leg, he clips it square for an easy single
Short legbreak outside off, Gill pulls to long-on
Quicker and flatter, full on off, Gill punches it to extra cover
Full on off, he clips it out to square leg
On a length on off, Gill hangs back and clips it out to long-on
Drops it short on off and Sai Sudharshan cuts it away to deep midwicket
Full on off, he flicks it away to deep square
Full on off, Sai Sudharshan defends. They contemplated a single as the ball fell to his left, but Curran was quick to get to it
Full on leg, he whips it away to deep midwicket's right for a single
Back of a length on middle, Gill punches it to mid-on
On a length on off, Gill defends
Shorter side of good length on leg, Gill nudges it away to deep midwicket and pushes for the second. And he gets it too
Shot! That's some way to get off the mark. Back of a length and he is on his toes and cuts it through point
On a length on off and angling into him, Sai Sudharshan defends it back to the bowler

100th IPL wicket for Rabada! Rabada sticks with the short ball strategy and Saha goes for another pull, but this time he picks out deep square leg! Short takes it above head-height and Saha has to walk
Another short ball, another attempted pull from Saha but he gets it off the toe-end and it goes through deep midwicket. Thankfully for Saha, there are no fielders there and he picks up two more
Just short of good length outside off, Saha punches behind point to the fielder in the deep for a brace
Back of a length on off, Saha wants to pull it away but can't connect cleanly and the ball rolls to his left
Brar lobs it up full on off and Saha skips out to swing it out to deep midwicket
On a length on off, Gill hangs back and caresses it to mid-off. They get a quick single
Goes full outside off, Saha gets down and sweeps to deep midwicket
Quicker and flatter on middle and off, Saha backs away and chops it to extra cover
Tosses it up full on off, Gill drives to mid-off for a single
Slapped past a diving point fielder. It's too short and too wide and Gill latches on to it in an instant. Waits on it and cuts it hard past Rahul Chahar
Edged but it falls short! Full outside off and angling in and Saha pokes at it. Gets a thin edge but the ball doesn't carry to Jitesh

And four more! This is cheekily done. It's full and wide and Saha jams his bat down and squeezes it between short third and backward point. Both fielders give chase and Brar almost gets to it, but the placement was too good and the ball races away

Pulled behind for four more! Another short ball, Saha swivels and pulls again. This time he gets a bit of a top edge and the ball balloons up to fine leg. No fielder there and it's a one-bounce boundary
Digs it in short outside off and Saha pulls on the swivel. Deep midwicket collects as the batters pick up two
Over the top now and he gets four more! Arshdeep goes full and angles it into him from outside off and Saha chips it over mid-on
Eased past cover. It's pitched up outside off and Saha just leans into it and meets it with a gentle push to cover's left. The fielder dives, but can't stop it from racing away
Too full, too straight and Gill is not missing out on that! It's full on leg, and he clips it away through the gap in front of midwicket
Rabada bangs it in short outside off and Gill gets it away to deep midwicket with the short-arm jab. Picks up two
Full on leg, Saha looks to tuck it fine but misses and it goes to backward square leg off his front pad
Rabada goes back of a length outside off and Saha steers it to point
Picks the gap! Rabada pitches it up outside off and Saha punches it between cover and mid-off with perfection
Full on off, Saha blocks to cover point
Full around off and going across him, Gill shoulders arms
On a length on off, Gill punches it to mid-off
Banged in short on  leg, Saha swivels and pulls to deep midwicket
Full on leg this time, swinging in, and Gill tucks it away to deep midwicket
Glorious Gill! Full outside off and that's all the invitation Gill needs. Just presses forward and caresses it between cover and mid-off
On a length on off, shaping in to Saha, who clips it square on the leg side to get off the mark
